caption: AI drafts can look polished but be wrong. These five prompts help diagnose, improve, apply, check, refine. Which prompt will you use first today? #AIatwork #Productivity #Entrepreneurship #DecisionMaking

slides.title: AI checks are too shallow
slides.body: Your AI output may look fine but be wrong. Here are five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, check, refine.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose errors
slides.body: Paste AI draft in [text]. List three factual errors and one unsupported claim; present as a numbered list; include sources.

slides.title: 2. Improve clarity
slides.body: Rewrite the draft in plain language for a non-expert audience, as a single paragraph under 150 words.

slides.title: 3. Add context
slides.body: Add three concrete, business-relevant examples from [your industry] that illustrate key points without new data.

slides.title: 4. Check bias
slides.body: Run a quick bias check: identify one potential bias and suggest a neutral alternative phrasing.

slides.title: 5. Ready-to-send
slides.body: Provide a 5-point go/no-go checklist to decide readiness.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use these prompts to stay honest with AI drafts; verification saves time and avoids errors.
